This collection brings together the main textbooks, external courses, and online resources named in the course materials. Individual weekly pages point to relevant readings.

## Where to begin

- **Numerical methods:** @judd1998.
- **Python and computational economics:** @quantecon-python, @coding-economists, and @quantecon.
- **Dynamic programming and reinforcement learning:** @bertsekas-course.
- **Computational macroeconomics:** @fernandez-villaverde-courses.
- **Machine learning:** @islp2023 and @feng-notes.

For replication-project papers, consult the [existing paper catalog](https://github.com/YaolangZhong/U_Tokyo_Comp_Econ_Course/blob/main/Final_Project/Paper_List/paper_info.md).
